summary_notes: Enterprise contact center for critical comms (regional gov + infrastructure operators).
Primary need: air-gapped, on-prem inference that can run in their FIPS-enabled datacenter with zero outbound egress.

Workloads: agent assist (real-time turn-by-turn suggestions), automated ticket summarization for post-call notes, tool-calling to ServiceNow and internal CRM, reranking for knowledge-base search during high-concurrency spikes.
SLA/Perf targets: agent-assist latency <= 350ms 95p for suggestions, embedding search top-K within 120ms, sustain spikes up to 20k concurrent agent sessions with graceful degradation policies.
Model preferences: open models acceptable if runtime supports quantized 8-bit + KV cache; desire deterministic fallbacks and auditable model versions for incident forensics.
Security: must integrate with on-prem KMS/HSM for model keys, support SAML SSO and enterprise audit logs with immutable retention (7+ years for certain records).
Integration: tight PBX+ACD integration, STT/voice post-processing pipeline, ServiceNow tool-calling via internal API gateway, allow controlled function/tool calling only inside tenant network.
Cost posture: medium — willing to commit to reserved for dedicated racks if predictable; POC to validate economics vs. do-it-yourself stack.
Quote from CISO: 'No internet egress, demonstrable key custody, and reproducible performance under load — that's non-negotiable.'
poc_requirements: 2-week on-prem air-gapped POC in their east-coast datacenter
No outbound internet; image delivered on USB / secure transfer; support for offline install and attestation
HSM integration (FIPS 140-2/3) for key management and model encryption
Demo flows: live agent-assist with voice-to-text->prompting->suggestion loop; ticket summarization pipeline ingesting 10k historical tickets
Load test: simulate 20k concurrent sessions; define graceful fallback (smaller model or cached suggestions)
Tool-calling: sample ServiceNow create/update and internal CRM write with RBAC and logged audit trail
technical_risks: Offline model updates process undefined; legal wants documented upgrade procedure
Latency target tight when STT + inference + reranking chain longer than 3 hops
Network ops require single-box proof for initial deploy before cluster expansion
